title: Refine flow CLI: add pager, improve flags
description:
Improve flow command CLI based on spike learnings:

Required flags:
- --format: text (default), svg, json, dot
- --output: file path (default: stdout for text, required for svg/json/dot)
- --show-done: include completed issues (default: hide)
- --goal <id>: highlight critical chain to specific goal issue

Consider for future:
- --pager: pipe text output through less/bat for horizontal scrolling
- --filter-status: filter by status
- --filter-type: filter by type
- --minimal: show only critical chain (with --goal)

Text output should go to stdout by default for pipeline friendliness.
Other formats should require explicit --output to avoid accidents.
